shared_elements: concentric circle / ring with central boss in relief
curvilinear, bilaterally symmetrical motif surrounding the central disc
shallow low-relief carving on a stone-like surface
paired lobed or crescent forms flanking a central axis
justification: Both surfaces carry a prominent ringed disc with a central boss framed by symmetrical curvilinear elements rendered in shallow relief, which is the single most specific correspondence. Otherwise the two differ fundamentally: A is a small, self-contained radially symmetric object with a toothed rim and nested concentric bands, while B is a vertically organised, weathered monumental surface where the motifs are strung along an axis rather than radiating from a centre.
